description: Source code implementing lazy freeing mechanisms in Redis, including functions for asynchronously freeing objects, databases, and various data structures, as well as tracking and statistics functions.

methods.name: lazyfreeFreeObject
methods.description: Decrements reference count of an object and updates lazyfree counters.

methods.name: lazyfreeFreeDatabase
methods.description: Releases database hash tables and updates counters.

methods.name: lazyFreeTrackingTable
methods.description: Releases radix tree tracking table and updates counters.

methods.name: lazyFreeLuaScripts
methods.description: Releases Lua scripts dictionary and updates counters.

methods.name: lazyFreeFunctionsCtx
methods.description: Releases functions context and updates counters.

methods.name: lazyFreeReplicationBacklogRefMem
methods.description: Releases replication backlog memory and updates counters.

methods.name: lazyfreeGetPendingObjectsCount
methods.description: Returns current count of objects pending free.

methods.name: lazyfreeGetFreedObjectsCount
methods.description: Returns total count of freed objects.

methods.name: lazyfreeResetStats
methods.description: Resets freed objects counter to zero.

methods.name: lazyfreeGetFreeEffort
methods.description: Estimates effort to free an object based on its type.

methods.name: freeObjAsync
methods.description: Decides whether to free an object synchronously or asynchronously based on effort.

methods.name: emptyDbAsync
methods.description: Creates a new empty database and schedules old one for lazy freeing.

methods.name: freeTrackingRadixTreeAsync
methods.description: Frees radix tree tracking structure asynchronously if large.

methods.name: freeLuaScriptsAsync
methods.description: Frees Lua scripts dictionary asynchronously if large.

methods.name: freeFunctionsAsync
methods.description: Frees functions context asynchronously if large.

methods.name: freeReplicationBacklogRefMemAsync
methods.description: Frees replication backlog memory asynchronously if large.
